stories.title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
stories.body: The talks fail to make a breakthrough on tackling climate change after a row about mentioning fossil fuels.

stories.title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
stories.body: The talks have been the longest-running in the summit's history, with negotiations breaking down two days after they had been due to end.

stories.title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
stories.body: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.

stories.title: 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes
stories.body: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford reports from the scene of a collapsed residential building in Ukraine's Kyiv region.

stories.title: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
stories.body: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on Saturday. Kyiv has yet to comment.

stories.title: South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal
stories.body: Choi Kyo-jin admits last-minute measures to stop AI-assisted cheating during the college entrance exam caused chaos.

stories.title: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
stories.body: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.

stories.title: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat
stories.body: Democrats have now won at least 258 seats in the midterms compared to Republicans, who hold at least 173 seats.

stories.title: US Army to detonate tonnes of unstable explosives in Iowa despite court order
stories.body: The Army says "swift action" is necessary to protect its personnel and nearby communities around its ammunition plant in Iowa.

stories.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in California ceremony
stories.body: The couple have been together for four years and were engaged in 2025.

stories.title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
stories.body: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores, who is accused of drug trafficking and torture, is detained after gun fight with authorities.

stories.title: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
stories.body: In a statement to Italian media, his family remember him as "the greatest jeweller of our time".

stories.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
stories.body: The National Crime Information Center database is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information.

stories.title: Lock of former US President George Washington's hair sells for $4,000
stories.body: The hair was given as a sign of friendship shortly before Washington's death in 1799, according to a descendent of its former owner.

stories.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting
stories.body: Ukraine's president says Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.

stories.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
stories.body: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

stories.title: Deal with EU not dependent on tuition fees agreement, Miliband says
stories.body: Brussels sources had previously suggested the bloc might not apply the wider deal until fees were lowered for EU students in Britain.

stories.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
stories.body: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.

stories.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
stories.body: The court has upheld the 2020 beating of the black music producer as an aggravated circumstance of racism.

stories.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
stories.body: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.
